赵爷爷听完王野的话后，起身对王野说：“去跟你娘打声招呼，咱去平老三家。今晚未必回来。”

王野知道他身上的问题可大可小。也没有犹豫去跟秦婉打了声招呼就跟赵爷爷一起向平三卓家走去。

两人来到平三卓家，老头正在门口闲聊。看见赵爷爷和王野一起来了就问：“老赵你怎么和小野一起过来了？”

赵爷爷笑呵呵的说：“嘿你这老小子，怎么你家我来不得呀？”

平三卓：“这四九城你老赵想去哪儿谁拦得住呀。”

赵爷爷得意的哼了一声说：“别在这儿晾着了，进屋有事儿找你。”

平三卓见赵爷爷严肃的说话，也知道是有正事儿。起身就带着两人进了院子，在院子里师娘正在收拾屋子，赶紧上前两步说：“小野来啦，吃了吗？没吃师娘给你去做点儿。”

王野赶紧说：“师娘别忙活了，我吃过了。”

平三卓说：“老婆子我和老赵有事儿你泡两杯茶来书房。”

平三卓带着赵爷爷和王野直接去了书房。刚坐下师娘就拿着一个茶壶和三个杯子进了书房。放下杯子就出了书房。王野赶紧给每个杯子里倒上茶水。

赵爷爷喝一口茶水把王野的情况一口气全跟平三卓解释了一遍。平三卓眉头微皱的看着赵爷爷说：“老赵，小野才16，你怎么就让他手上沾上人命了。是不是早了点儿。”

王野听了这话感觉不对呀心想：“什么叫早了点，难道等几年这俩老头还要安排自己手上沾点人命呀，这俩老头是好人吧。应该是好人，可是好人会安排自己的弟子沾人命吗？”王野疑惑的看向两个老头。

赵爷爷白了王野一眼没好气的说：“看个屁呀，那个练武的手上没两条人命的。就算是没安国那趟，过两年我也会安排你去刑场见见血。”

平三卓说：“伸手，用上你们的呼吸法。”

王野伸出手放在桌上，平三卓三指轻触在王野的脉搏跳动处。眼睛微闭，片刻间，眉头微微一蹙，似是捕捉到了脉象中那一丝隐匿的异常波动。

平三卓收回手指睁开眼睛说：“是有问题，最近先别用你们的呼吸法了。你们那个太过暴戾了，先用我这一套吧。以后小野学点修身养性的东西。”

王野疑惑的问：“什么修身养性呀”。

平三卓说：“琴棋书画，养花钓鱼，随便。”

王野心想：“琴就算了，这东西是需要天赋的。王野不论前世还是现在唱歌都是五音不全，前世王野听说有人天生音乐感知和表现力不足。”

“棋也不行，就王野的脑子这东西起不到修身养性的作用。画画也不太行，这东西现在多是国画要是素描王野可以学学。养花也不行条件不允许呀，要是在空间里养也没什么作用呀。钓鱼就更别说自己钓鱼太暴力了。唯一剩下的就是书法了。”

王野说：“还是学学书法吧。”

平三卓说：“书法也行，明天我带你去找个老师教教你。”

王野心气低落的说：“又给我找个师父呀？”

平三卓没好气的说：“想什么呢，我可没老赵那么大气，能把弟子平分出去，就是个老师。”王野觉得这就是只许州官放火，不许百姓点灯吧。

赵爷爷问：“你要介绍谁呀，我认识吗？”

After listening to Wang Ye's words, Grandpa Zhao stood up and said to Wang Ye: "Go and say hello to your mother. Let's go to Ping Laosan's house. We may not come back tonight."

Wang Ye knew that his problems could be big or small.He didn't hesitate to say hello to Qin Wan and walked to Ping Sanzhuo's house with Grandpa Zhao.

The two came to Ping Sanzhuo's house, and the old man was chatting at the door.When he saw Grandpa Zhao coming with Wang Ye, he asked, "Old Zhao, why did you come here with Xiao Ye?"

Grandpa Zhao said with a smile: "Hey, you old boy, why can't I come to your house?"

Ping Sanzhuo: "Who can stop you, Lao Zhao, wherever you want to go in these 49 cities?"

Grandpa Zhao snorted proudly and said, "Stop hanging here to dry. I'll see you if I have anything to do when I come in."

Seeing Grandpa Zhao speaking seriously, Ping Sanzhuo knew that something was serious.He got up and took the two of them into the yard. In the yard, the master's wife was cleaning up the house. She quickly stepped forward and said, "Xiaoye is here. Have you eaten? If not, the master's wife will make you something."

Wang Ye quickly said: "Master, please stop working, I've eaten."

Ping Sanzhuo said: "Old lady, Lao Zhao and I have something to do. Please make two cups of tea and come to the study."

Ping Sanzhuo took Grandpa Zhao and Wang Ye directly to the study.As soon as she sat down, the mistress came into the study with a teapot and three cups.He put down the cup and left the study.Wang Ye quickly poured tea into each cup.

Grandpa Zhao took a sip of tea and explained Wang Ye's situation to Ping Sanzhuo in one breath.Ping Sanzhuo frowned slightly and looked at Grandpa Zhao and said: "Old Zhao, Xiaoye is only 16, why did you let him get a life on his hands? Isn't it a little early?"

After hearing this, Wang Ye felt something was wrong and thought to himself: "What do you mean it's too early? How could these two old men arrange to get some lives on their hands after a few years? These two old men are good people. They should be good people, but would good people arrange for their disciples to get some lives on their hands?" Wang Ye looked at the two old men doubtfully.

Grandpa Zhao rolled his eyes at Wang Ye and said angrily: "What the hell, that martial arts practitioner doesn't have two lives on his hands. Even if we don't go to Anguo, in two years I will arrange for you to go to the execution ground and see the blood."

Ping Sanzhuo said: "Reach out your hands and use your breathing techniques."

Wang Ye stretched out his hand and put it on the table. Ping Sanzhuo's three fingers lightly touched Wang Ye's pulse.His eyes were slightly closed, and for a moment, his brows were slightly furrowed, as if he had caught the hidden abnormal fluctuation in his pulse.

Ping Sanzhuo retracted his fingers and opened his eyes and said: "There is a problem. Don't use your breathing method recently. You are too violent, so use my method first. From now on, Xiaoye will learn something about self-cultivation."

Wang Ye asked doubtfully: "What about cultivating one's moral character?"

Ping Sanzhuo said: "Play chess, calligraphy and painting, grow flowers and fish, whatever you want."

Wang Ye thought: "Forget the piano, this thing requires talent. Wang Ye was tone-deaf both in his previous life and now when he sang. In his previous life, Wang Ye heard that some people were born with insufficient musical perception and expression."

"Not good at chess, Wang Ye's brain is not good at cultivating his character. He's not good at painting either. Most of these things are traditional Chinese paintings now. If Wang Ye can learn sketching, he can't do it. He's not good at growing flowers. Conditions don't allow him to grow them. It's useless if he grows them in space. Fishing, let alone fishing by himself, is too violent. The only thing left is calligraphy."

Wang Ye said: "Let's learn calligraphy."

Ping Sanzhuo said: "Calligraphy is also good. I will take you to find a teacher to teach you tomorrow."

Wang Ye said dejectedly: "Find me another master?"

Ping Sanzhuo said angrily: "What are you thinking? I am not as grand as Old Zhao. If I can divide the disciples equally, I am just a teacher." Wang Ye felt that this meant that only the state officials were allowed to set fires and the people were not allowed to light lamps.

Grandpa Zhao asked: "Who do you want to introduce? Do I know him?"
